introduction: New Jersey uses a shared application for LIHEAP and the Universal Service Fund. Apply through DCAid or an authorized local agency and explain any pending shutoff.
description: New Jersey uses a shared application for LIHEAP and the Universal Service Fund. Apply through DCAid or an authorized local agency and explain any pending shutoff.

sections.who: LIHEAP considers household income and responsibility for heating or medically necessary cooling costs, including some costs within rent. USF has its own utility-cost assessment; one submission is not automatic approval of both.
sections.get: LIHEAP offsets qualifying energy costs; USF credits help with qualifying electric or gas bills. Ask how an approved benefit reaches your account and what balance remains.
sections.docs:

  • Household income evidence.
  • Identity and residence information requested by the application.
  • Any medical cooling documentation or shutoff notice relevant to the request.
sections.apply:
1. Use the shared application

    Go to DCAid and select USF/Home Energy Assistance.

  2. Request assistance if needed

    Call 800-510-3102 for local intake help or ask about a home visit if disabled and homebound.

  3. Complete document requests

    Submit the required proof and check status messages and email.
sections.after: The FFY 2027 LIHEAP fact sheet lists October 1, 2026–June 30, 2027, subject to available funding. USF applications continue year-round. Confirm current availability before relying on a projected payment.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Current FFY 2027 LIHEAP/USF fact sheet, Shared application and assistance options, Year-round USF and status guidance. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Do LIHEAP and USF need separate initial forms?
The state says they share an application.
Can I apply for USF outside the LIHEAP season?
Yes. The state lists year-round USF intake.
Does receiving SNAP automatically enroll me?
No. Data may be checked, but energy-program eligibility and additional proof still apply.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
